description: Connect this computer to the human's DropTheHassle account with one link, so the account tools work (here and in the terminal). Returns a link and a short code: give both to the human. They log in or sign up there and approve. Call connect again after they say they approved: it waits for the approval. Free; the token it saves can never pay. Never buy anything without asking me. Never buy a domain, email or subscription for me without asking first. When something costs money, give me the payment link and let me pay.
name: connect
